@graph.comment: MemTriggerListener — subscribes to MonitoringStore 'changed' events on the wiki-memory containers, runs cross-resource detectors (BoundExceeded, ContradictionDetected, ReflectionDue, UnprocessableWrite), and emits mem:Event activities to <storageBase>/wiki/.events/. eventsContainer + typeIndexUri are DERIVED in the listener from baseUrl + storagePath (R-T4 / audit M1) — empty string here means derive; a non-empty value would override. v1 attaches the listener + filter pipeline; only the BoundExceeded path is wired (currently a stub). The other three detectors are instantiated for future use. See FOLLOWUPS.md ('Phase C.10 — MemTrigger v1 wiring').
Standalone UnprocessableWriteDetector for MemTriggerUnprocessableWriteHook. Stateless — no concurrency concern with MemTriggerListener's internal instance.

MemTriggerUnprocessableWriteHook — fired by ShaclValidator on 422 rejections. Builds a mem:UnprocessableWrite Turtle event and enqueues it in the module-level pendingEventsBuffer (breaks the ResourceStore circular-dep that would arise from direct store injection). MemTriggerListener drains the buffer to the Pod in its handle() phase (T12). Only detector injected — no EventEmitter at construction time.
Bind ShaclValidator's unprocessableHook to MemTrigger impl when mem-trigger is installed. Overrides the NoOpUnprocessableWriteHook default declared in solid-config.json.

Standalone ContradictionDetector for MemTriggerPostProjectionHook. v1 pair list is wikilink-projected cito:agreesWith vs cito:disagreesWith (from [[X]]{.supports} / {.criticizes}). The generator emits the constructor opts.contradictoryPairs param as opts_contradictoryPairs in Components.js context.

MemTriggerPostProjectionHook — fired by MarkdownProjectionListener after .meta projection completes. Runs ContradictionDetector over <#this>-subject edges; enqueues any mem:ContradictionDetected Turtle in pendingEventsBuffer. Same buffer pattern as MemTriggerUnprocessableWriteHook — no ResourceStore reference at construction time.
Bind MarkdownProjectionListener's postProjectionHook to MemTrigger impl when mem-trigger is installed. Overrides the NoOpPostProjectionHook default declared in markdown-projection.json.

Bind MarkdownBodyProjector's postProjectionHook to MemTrigger impl when mem-trigger is installed. Overrides the NoOpPostProjectionHook default declared in markdown-projection.json. Uses the same hook instance so ContradictionDetector receives events from BOTH the in-band floor path (MarkdownBodyProjector.materialize) AND the backstop listener path (MarkdownProjectionListener.project) — restoring C-T4b: ContradictionDetector hears in-band writes again.

Replace WorkerParallelInitializer handlers with all four listeners. This Override is imported AFTER markdown-projection.json (which sets [Memento, MarkdownProjection]) so its overrideParameters wins. K1: only one Override per instance, hence the consolidation pattern (same as memento.json ↔ markdown-projection.json relationship). All four listeners MUST be listed here because Override semantics replace rather than append. ops-index appended at the tail: CDC order = Memento (git) → MarkdownProjection (meta projection) → MemTrigger (event emission) → OpsIndex (back-pointer derivation).
